description: git.createGit(...).status with a scripted runner. Input: {responses, root}. responses maps a subcommand (--version, rev-parse, config, status) to {code, stdout | tokens, stderr, missing}; tokens are joined with NUL and each followed by NUL. An unlisted subcommand answers code 0 with empty output. Expected: {result, calls}, where result is the status answer and calls lists every git argv in order, space-joined, including the safety flags.

a folder that is not a repository says so
a driver name that could slip past the override refuses the repository
